advertisements.title: Dead Mail
advertisements.description:
A courier delivered a parcel to my grave. I would like to complain in person.

The marker has my name, my date of birth and tomorrow’s date as the day I die. I remain alive and would prefer to keep it that way.

A discreet investigator is required. Please do not send flowers.

advertisements.title: Dead Men Calling
advertisements.description:
My late husband keeps leaving messages. The phone company says this is not covered by my plan.

He wants me to find a document and tell no one. I would like to know who is really calling. Preferably someone alive.

advertisements.title: Someone has been using my alibi
advertisements.description:
Three strangers claim they were having dinner with me on Tuesday.

I ate alone. I would like to know why I suddenly have friends.

advertisements.title: Mirror for sale. Slight delay.
advertisements.description:
Excellent condition. Reflection approximately three seconds behind.

Buyer collects. Please do not wave at it after midnight.

advertisements.title: Seeking a discreet pigeon
advertisements.description:
Must be reliable, punctual and unfamiliar with the police.

Previous courier experience preferred. Breadcrumbs provided.
